sources.text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — NOT A REAL CLIENT DOCUMENT On March 1, 2026, Orion Studio and Finch Research signed this sample services agreement. The project starts on March 15, 2026 and ends on June 30, 2026. Either party may terminate the agreement by giving the other party thirty days of written notice. The client must pay each invoice within fifteen days after receiving it. Confidential information must not be disclosed to third parties without prior written consent. This sample does not specify a governing law or a dispute resolution forum.
